prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing / compositing. Create an alternative FINISHED connected Google Play screenshot campaign for Lucro Caseiro, markedly LIGHTER AND AIRIER than reference image 1. ONE panoramic canvas EXACT ratio 9:4 (2.25:1), highest available resolution, ideally 4320x1920. Will be cut into FOUR equal 9:16 panels. No gutters. The same fictional entrepreneur from reference 1 should reappear with consistent face, dark curls, medium brown skin, ivory shirt and dusty rose apron.
ART DIRECTION: very light warm ivory #FFFCF7 background, almost white, pale blush #F8EEF0 very subtle large curved field only in lower third, plenty of negative space. Matte editorial photography and crisp app screenshots. Soft rose #B9687C accents, charcoal-brown #503C42 typography. No dark burgundy background. No satin ribbons, no stars, no glitter, no props scattered around, no flowers, no thick metallic frames, no floating cards, no heavy shadows, no gradients or busy texture. Relaxed, human and polished. Fine typography: clear friendly medium-weight modern sans-serif for headlines, gentle contrast, not giant black serif. Short 2-3 line headlines; generous spacing. Continuous pale pink soft wave at bottom connects all 4 panels, extremely understated. One thin dusty-pink line moves gently along this low wave crossing seams with continuity. No vertical seam lines.
QUARTER 1: top small brand "Lucro Caseiro", generous breathing room. Headline EXACT "Seu talento.\nSeu negócio." supporting "Mais organização para o seu dia a dia." Below a natural editorial portrait of SAME friendly woman from reference 1, waist-up, holding same kraft box at her waist, smiling gently. Isolate her against bright cream studio background with beautiful soft daylight, no dark cafe setting. Face fully inside quarter 1, woman centered with margins, elbow can extend slightly to quarter 2. She occupies lower ~60%. Light cream tabletop continuing across full panorama bottom edge.
QUARTER 2: small label "PRECIFICAÇÃO". Headline EXACT "Seu preço,\ncom clareza." Supporting "Entenda custos, margem e lucro." One large upright Android app screenshot from reference 2 in a very thin OFF-WHITE frame with tiny soft shadow, NO camera hole or notch added. Screen starts at 32% height, reaches bottom. Preserve actual app colors and layout. Pricing R$30,49; lucro R$7,39; margem 24%. All text, values and UI faithfully as reference. Do not recreate alternative interfaces.
QUARTER 3: small label "CATÁLOGO". Headline EXACT "Uma vitrine\npara compartilhar." Supporting "Seus produtos e serviços em um só link." One large upright actual screenshot from reference 3, same thin ivory frame, same scale and alignment as quarter 2. Preserve screenshot content.
QUARTER 4: small label "FINANCEIRO". Headline EXACT "Suas finanças,\nmais simples." Supporting "Acompanhe o que entra e o que sai." One large upright actual screenshot from reference 4, same thin ivory frame and alignment. Preserve original values R$31,30, R$1.077,00, R$1.045,70, actual interface and colors.
SAFE CROP: each quarter's text and entire width of phone remain inside its own quarter with minimum 8% of quarter-width margin on both sides. No letters or faces cross cuts. Only pale background wave and fine line cross seams. Four panels feel like a single quiet visual narrative. ALL headlines about same font size, not oversized; maintain lots of airy space. Text not overlap phones. Phones remain large enough to read. No design labels, no numbers denoting panels. Portuguese exact spelling, accents. Single connected panorama, no collage border. This is a lighter variation of reference 1, not same dark treatment.
